prompt: Write bst.py: a BinarySearchTree with insert(value) that ignores duplicates, contains(value), inorder() returning the held values sorted, and height() returning the number of levels (0 for an empty tree, 1 for a single node).

setup.test_bst.py:
from bst import BinarySearchTree


def test_insert_then_contains():
    tree = BinarySearchTree()
    tree.insert(5)
    tree.insert(3)
    tree.insert(8)
    assert tree.contains(5)
    assert tree.contains(3)
    assert tree.contains(8)
    assert not tree.contains(4)


def test_inorder_returns_sorted_values():
    tree = BinarySearchTree()
    for value in (7, 3, 9, 1, 5):
        tree.insert(value)
    assert tree.inorder() == [1, 3, 5, 7, 9]


def test_duplicates_are_ignored():
    tree = BinarySearchTree()
    tree.insert(2)
    tree.insert(2)
    assert tree.inorder() == [2]
    assert tree.height() == 1


def test_height_counts_levels():
    tree = BinarySearchTree()
    assert tree.height() == 0
    tree.insert(1)
    assert tree.height() == 1
    tree.insert(2)
    assert tree.height() == 2
    tree.insert(3)
    assert tree.height() == 3
